pv_tilt_degrees.notes: Egypt rooftop fixed-tilt rule of thumb.

capex_per_kw_egp.source: Egyptian consumer/commercial solar market guides, 2026 (average installed on-grid cost EGP 8.90-11/W excluding batteries)
capex_per_kw_egp.notes: Midpoint of a real but consumer-facing market range (EGP 8,900-11,000/kW), not a verified industrial EPC quote. Utility/industrial-scale projects typically achieve economies of scale below small commercial pricing, so this may still overstate cost at 350-500 kW; replace with a direct EPC quote before formal use.

discount_rate_pct.notes: State nominal-vs-real in finance module output.

tariff_retail_egp_per_kwh.source: Official Egyptian electricity tariff schedule, Medium Voltage (22-11 kV), "Other Users" bracket: 255.0 Pt/kWh
tariff_retail_egp_per_kwh.notes: Matches the golden case's 22kV connection voltage. Exact decision/gazette number and effective date were not captured in this research pass; confirm current effective tariff with EgyptERA/the distribution company before formal use, since Egyptian tariffs are revised periodically.

export_price_egp_per_kwh.source: Net-metering credit commonly described as ~50% of retail tariff in Egyptian market guides (2026); not an EgyptERA-published compensation rate
export_price_egp_per_kwh.notes: Golden case uses self_consumption (zero export by design), so this only matters for a net_metering scenario. Computed as 50% x tariff_retail_egp_per_kwh; EgyptERA Circular No. 4/2026 sets the net-metering capacity/process but no explicit compensation rate was located in this research pass.

financing_rate_pct.source: Credit Agricole Egypt solar financing product: ~20% decreasing interest rate, up to 100% of cost, 7-year tenor (accessed 2026)
financing_rate_pct.notes: A real named bank product, not a generic proxy. CIB's comparable solar-showcased personal loan quotes 21.5% flat; Credit Agricole's decreasing-rate product was used as the reference since it is explicitly a solar financing product.

financing_term_years.source: Credit Agricole Egypt solar financing product tenor (accessed 2026)
financing_term_years.notes: Matches the same product as financing_rate_pct.

down_payment_pct.source: QNB Egypt Green Loan: covers up to 80% of system cost, up to EGP 400,000, tenors up to 84 months (accessed 2026)
down_payment_pct.notes: Real bank products range from 80% (QNB Green Loan, modeled here) to 100% (Credit Agricole) financing. 100% financing was tried first but produces a near-zero-equity IRR/payback that is mathematically correct but not presentable (IRR ~870%); 20% down avoids that degenerate case while staying a real, cited product.

financing_fees_pct.source: CIB Personal Loan for Solar Finance fee schedule: Administration Fees 1% of total loan amount (accessed 2026)
financing_fees_pct.notes: Excludes CIB's other line items (assessment fee EGP 200, service fee, stamp duty) not modeled here.

area_per_kw_m2.notes: Includes inter-row spacing on flat roof.

tariff_escalation_variability_pct.notes: Relative width around tariff_escalation_pct; Egyptian industrial tariffs have moved sharply in recent years.

financing_rate_variability_pct.notes: Relative width around financing_rate_pct; used only for the finance scenario.
